scope: DynamicValue storage, DefineDynamicValue/SetDynamicValue canonical transitions, and PostfixExpr decoding/evaluation for the reviewed TurnBasedGameData formula bytecode. Target-context construction remains a separate Target packet.

evidence.support: 1347 PostfixExpr instances in the v2 canonical corpus; all 18 distinct opcode programs decode with the selected token grammar.
R4 local evidence for DynamicValue ValueType tags and tag-aware coercion primitives.
DynamicValue definitions and operation argument payloads are preserved losslessly.

selected_model.postfix_encoding: OpCodes is a base64 byte stream. 0x00/0x01 start two-byte operand tokens (FIXED index / DYNAMIC hash index); 0x11 is END; every other byte is an operation.
selected_model.evaluation: Decimal arithmetic with 38 significant digits; division by zero is an explicit semantic error, never a silent zero.
selected_model.store_scope: ContextCaster, ContextOwner, ContextModifier, TargetEntity and ContextAbility are recognized scope labels. When ContextScope is absent the selected default is ContextCaster; this default remains an explicit R3 ambiguity.
selected_model.define_dynamic_value: If the selected owner does not already hold DynamicKey, create it with ResetValue when present, otherwise 0. If the key exists, no transition is recorded. ResetValue evaluation uses the same value-spec decoder.
selected_model.set_dynamic_value: Evaluate Value (fixed or PostfixExpr) in the operation context, then overwrite DynamicKey on the selected scope owner. The write commits before the following sibling operation per KERNEL-EVENT-001 state visibility.
selected_model.write_visibility: A SetDynamicValue write is visible to every later operation in the same behavior record and to nested events dispatched after the committing primitive boundary. It is not visible to earlier siblings.
selected_model.record_definitions: record-level DynamicValues definitions are static metadata; runtime DynamicHashes that are not resolvable from those definitions must be supplied by an explicit DynamicValue resolver packet and are never guessed.

unsupported_cases: operation bytes 0x06..0x0d and 0x0f (not observed in the reviewed corpus)
array/map DynamicValue cells as arithmetic operands
read-after-write across immediate native dispatch modes beyond the KERNEL-EVENT selected model
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_dynamic_value_reference.py proves direct load, ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV/NEG programs, malformed-program rejection, deterministic define/set/read store transitions, and fixed/formula value-spec extraction.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement the PostfixProgram decoder exactly as specified, use arbitrary-precision decimal arithmetic with explicit division-by-zero errors, and keep the dynamic store immutable/deterministic. Any unsupported opcode or unresolved DynamicHash must reject the behavior record rather than approximate.
